# 批量下单 (TRADE)

- **POST** `/capi/v3/batchOrders`

**请求权重**

10s order rate limit(X-ORDER-COUNT-10S)为5; 1min order rate limit(X-ORDER-COUNT-1M)为5; IP rate limit(X-USED-WEIGHT-1M)为0

**请求参数**

| 参数名 | 类型 | 是否必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| batchOrders | `Array<PlaceOrder>` | 是 | 单次最多 5 笔订单。每个元素与[下单 (TRADE)](/api-doc/zh-CN/contract/Transaction_API/PlaceOrder) 的字段一致。 |

**请求示例**

```
curl -X POST "https://api-contract.weex.com/capi/v3/batchOrders" \
   -H "ACCESS-KEY:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-SIGN:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-PASSPHRASE:*****" \
   -H "ACCESS-TIMESTAMP:1659076670000" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   -d '{
     "batchOrders": [
       {
         "symbol": "BTCUSDT",
         "side": "BUY",
         "positionSide": "LONG",
         "type": "LIMIT",
         "timeInForce": "GTC",
         "quantity": "0.01",
         "price": "69000",
         "newClientOrderId": "batch-1"
       }
     ]
   }'
```

**返回参数**

返回一个数组，数组元素与[下单 (TRADE)](/api-doc/zh-CN/contract/Transaction_API/PlaceOrder) 的响应结构一致。

**返回示例**

```
[
  {
    "orderId": "702345678901234567",
    "clientOrderId": "batch-1",
    "success": true,
    "errorCode": "",
    "errorMessage": ""
  }
]
```
